{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
p='specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s=open(p).read()

# 1. Header: status + last updated
s=s.replace('**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "Build tinydb.journal.BatchWriter(db), wrapping a supplied TinyDB instance without changing its ordinary APIs. Use the default table only. apply(operations) accepts a list of operation dictionaries (insert/remove), returns inserted document IDs, and is atomic: on any error the complete pre-batch default-table data is restored. Ordinary TinyDB reads/writes and preexisting documents continue to work; inserted and returned nested data must not alias the caller\'s input."',
'**Status**: Draft (updated for milestone 2 and Claim-A extensions)\n**Last Updated**: 2026-10-17\n\n**Input**: User description: "Build tinydb.journal.BatchWriter(db), wrapping a supplied TinyDB instance without changing its ordinary APIs. Use the default table only. apply(operations) accepts a list of operation dictionaries (insert/remove), returns inserted document IDs, and is atomic: on any error the complete pre-batch default-table data is restored. Ordinary TinyDB reads/writes and preexisting documents continue to work; inserted and returned nested data must not alias the caller\'s input."\n\n**Requirement history**: Milestone 1 defined R01-R03. Milestone 2 added R04-R06 and a conflicting-evidence packet (an older generated note claiming preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted; that note is unverified and superseded by R04/R05 - see the Conflict Resolution section). Claim-A candidate extensions added R05b (detached preview results) and an R05 clarification (persistent ID-sequence continuation). All earlier requirements remain active unless explicitly replaced here.')
assert 'Requirement history' in s
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('header ok')
PY"}
